name: A Gaoled Awakening
premise: Break out of a forced-labour dig site and survive the escape.

name: Tale's Beginning
premise: Wake beside a waterfall after the escape and find your way to safety with a soldier's help.

name: In Dragon's Wake
premise: Rest up at Borderwatch Outpost, then head for Melve after news of an attack.
tips: How fully you stick with Watchhead Gregor changes how this quest wraps up.

name: Seat of the Sovran
premise: Travel to the capital and prove who you really are.

name: Monster Culling
premise: Take on three jobs for Captain Brant around Vermund.
tips: The jobs: goblins at Trevo Mine, saurians at Harve Village and a delivery to Vermund's eastern edge.

name: Disa's Plot
premise: Find proof of wrongdoing inside the castle.
tips: Use the rear gate between midnight and dawn. Bring a lantern.

name: The Caged Magistrate
premise: Free an imprisoned magistrate from the gaol tower.

name: The Stolen Throne
premise: Slip into a royal masquerade to look into a false Sovran.
tips: Formal clothes help you blend in at the masquerade.

name: An Unsettling Encounter
premise: Sneak into a noble's chambers after a tip about a suspicious delivery.

name: Feast of Deception
premise: Attend the coronation and see what the Godsway can do.
tips: Several Vernworth side quests close when this starts. Check the Missable list.

name: Nation of the Lambent Flame
premise: Cross the border into Battahl, looking for answers about the Godsway.

name: Flickering Shadows
premise: Investigate researchers who use blue crystals, and what they are powering.

name: Convergence
premise: Explore a structure that has risen from the sea near Harve.

name: A New Godsway
premise: Gather what you need to restore a special blade.
tips: Treat this as the last safe point for side quests you care about.

name: The Guardian Gigantus
premise: Defend against a giant on the march toward Moonglint Tower.
tips: Earlier side quests decide who turns up to help.

name: Legacy
premise: Face the Dragon at Moonglint Tower.
tips: What you choose here decides the ending. Read the Endings card only if you want it spoiled.

name: The Provisioner's Plight
premise: Help the outpost's supply officer track down missing provisions.
unlock: After In Dragon's Wake

name: Ordeals of a New Recruit
premise: Look for a young recruit who went missing on a scouting run.
unlock: After In Dragon's Wake
failure: If you are too slow, the recruit dies.

name: Claw Them Into Shape
premise: Help a seasoned warrior train a group of raw recruits.
unlock: After In Dragon's Wake. Also: In Dragon's Wake progress

name: Beren's Final Lesson
premise: Go with Beren on one last outing with his recruits.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran + Claw Them Into Shape
tips: Unlocks: Warrior Maister skill Champion's Fable.

name: Spellbound
premise: Help a struggling student of magick find what she needs to study.
unlock: After In Dragon's Wake. Also: reach Eini's Home

name: Medicament Predicament
premise: Fetch medicine for a sick villager in Melve.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran. Also: reach Melve

name: Brothers Brave and Timid
premise: Find out what happened to a boy's brother who went off to fight.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran. Also: reach Melve

name: Nesting Troubles
premise: Deal with a monster problem threatening Melve.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran. Also: - (cancelled if you do any main quest for Brant)

name: Readvent of Calamity
premise: Help Melve stand against a dragon threat.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: Seat of the Sovran + Scaly Invaders; cancels at Feast of Deception

items: outcome Repel vs Fell the dragon

name: Home is Where the Hearth Is
premise: Help Melve's people defend their home against hostile soldiers.
unlock: After Readvent of Calamity + An Unsettling Encounter. Also: Readvent of Calamity + Trouble on the Cape
failure: Time-limited. The villagers fight alone if you are late.

name: Oxcart Courier
premise: Deliver a letter by riding the oxcart to Melve.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran. Also: pay 100G to ride to Melve

name: Vocation Frustration
premise: Fetch weapons for the Vocation Guild so new vocations open up.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran. Also: speak to Klaus

name: A Place to Call Home
premise: Ask about buying a house of your own in Vernworth.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: speak to her

name: The Heel of History
premise: Lend a hand to a slum charity that feeds the poor.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: donate food twice

name: A Case of Sculptor's Block
premise: Help a sculptor finish a statue of you.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: progress story

name: The Gift of Giving
premise: Find out who is secretly helping the people of the slums.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: reach Slums
tips: Unlocks: House of the Blue Sunbright.

name: House of the Blue Sunbright
premise: Track down a missing person tied to a slum mystery.
unlock: After The Gift of Giving

name: The Nameless Village
premise: Look into a hidden village of thieves.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: between Caged Magistrate and Stolen Throne

name: The Arisen's Shadow
premise: Find out who has been pretending to be the Arisen.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: complete Brant's quests

name: A Beggar's Tale
premise: Help a beggar who has a secret life.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: speak to Benton or get Beggar's Garb

name: Gift of the Bow
premise: Bring a bow to an elf archer who wants to judge your skill.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: Archer vocation

name: A Trial of Archery
premise: Take part in an archery contest held by the elves.
unlock: After Gift of the Bow

name: Till Death Do Us Part
premise: Find a missing husband before it is too late.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: hear rumor of Ser Ludolph, talk to Margit
failure: If you are too slow, Gregor dies (you still get some rewards).

name: Saint of the Slums
premise: Gather evidence on what is really going on at a slum clinic.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests, maybe after The Heel of History. Also: overhear Vlasiy/Elena

name: The Ornate Box
premise: Find a fancy box that a servant needs.
unlock: After In Dragon's Wake. Also: Seat of the Sovran; cancels if you pass Disa's Plot

name: Masked Correspondence
premise: Carry a secret letter for a castle servant.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests, likely after The Ornate Box (reported). Also: Seat of the Sovran

name: Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
premise: Find a smith who can restore an old ceremonial sword.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: Seat of the Sovran

name: A Magisterial Amenity
premise: Check in on a freed magistrate after a few days.
unlock: After The Caged Magistrate. Also: Caged Magistrate + wait days

name: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
premise: Gather evidence for a noblewoman who wants justice.
unlock: After Feast of Deception. Also: access to Battahl; evidence within 3 days
failure: If time runs out, Wilhelmina is jailed. Finish Brant's quests first.

name: A Veil of Gossamer Clouds
premise: Find a letter for a castle servant.
unlock: After Feast of Deception

name: The Phantom Oxcart
premise: Investigate a ghostly oxcart that moves contraband.
unlock: After Nation of the Lambent Flame. Also: enter Bakbattahl after Lambent Flame; locked out by A New Godsway

name: Tensions on the Highroad
premise: Settle a dispute between two men on the road.
unlock: After Nation of the Lambent Flame. Also: Welcome to Battahl

name: A Noble Exchange
premise: Catch a thief at a noble gathering.
unlock: Between Nation of the Lambent Flame and A New Godsway. Also: masquerade ball

name: Crossing in Shadow
premise: Help a woman hide from people looking for her.
unlock: After A Place to Call Home + A Candle in the Storm. Also: own house + A Candle in the Storm
failure: Best reward only if you are on time.

name: Scaly Invaders
premise: Clear out saurians troubling Harve Village.
unlock: During Monster Culling. Also: second Harve visit

name: Trouble on the Cape
premise: Help Harve deal with a dangerous visitor.
unlock: During Readvent of Calamity. Also: Scaly Invaders + Readvent progress
tips: Unlocks: Home is Where the Hearth Is.

name: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
premise: Prove yourself to an eccentric sorcerer who likes fine clothes.
unlock: During Vernworth main quests. Also: wear fancy clothing

name: Hunt for the Jadeite Orb
premise: Two buyers want the same orb. Find it and decide who gets it.
unlock: After Seat of the Sovran

name: Prey for the Pack
premise: Rescue a missing man before wolves get to him.
unlock: On reaching Checkpoint Rest Town. Also: reach town; fail if Rodge not reached in time
failure: If you are too slow, Rodge dies.

name: Mercy among Thieves
premise: Look into a group of thieves who prey on travellers.
unlock: After crossing into Battahl. Also: pass border gate, offer food to Toumi
tips: Unlocks: related: Off the Pilfered Path.

name: Tolled to Rest
premise: Help a man recover a key and explore an old battleground.
unlock: On entering. Also: save Oskar on the road

name: A Game of Wits
premise: Answer the riddles of a mysterious sphinx.
unlock: On finding the Sphinx. Also: reach shrine
tips: Unlocks: second Sphinx site after 5 riddles.

name: Welcome to Battahl
premise: Get pulled into a fight at a Bakbattahl inn.
unlock: On reaching Bakbattahl. Also: reach Bakbattahl

name: Shadowed Prayers
premise: Catch an assassin before they strike.
unlock: On reaching Bakbattahl. Also: Lambent Flame progress
failure: If you fail, Nadinia dies, A Candle in the Storm and Crossing in Shadow fail, and you can't buy the Bakbattahl house.

name: A Poisonous Proposal
premise: Help a man who fears his wife is being poisoned.
unlock: After Nation of the Lambent Flame

name: Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
premise: Bring the ceremonial sword to Bakbattahl's master smith.
unlock: After Dulled Steel, Cold Forge

name: Out of the Forest, Into the Forge
premise: Help an elf deliver something to a smith in Bakbattahl.
unlock: After The Ailing Arborheart
failure: Timed. The penalty is not confirmed yet.

name: Short-Sighted Ambition
premise: A merchant asks for help finding a strange book.
unlock: After Nation of the Lambent Flame
tips: Unlocks: bad outcome opens a Hugo job (Off the Pilfered Path).

name: Off the Pilfered Path
premise: Help find out who is behind a string of thefts.
unlock: After Nation of the Lambent Flame + Mercy among Thieves. Also: certain quests

name: 'Twixt a Rock and a Hard Place
premise: Help someone caught between two bad options in Bakbattahl.
unlock: On reaching Bakbattahl

name: Put a Spring in Thy Step
premise: Help an elder on the volcanic island and learn a new fighting style.
unlock: On reaching island. Also: explore Drabnir's Grotto, reach island

name: The Sotted Sage
premise: Track down a drunken sage who can teach a unique vocation.
unlock: On reaching island. Also: reach hamlet
achievement: Jack of All Trades, Master of…All Trades

name: A Candle in the Storm
premise: Protect an important figure during a risky meeting.
unlock: After Shadowed Prayers

name: Clash and Conclusion
premise: Settle things with an old rival during the giant's attack.
unlock: During The Guardian Gigantus, only if Tensions on the Highroad done and Raghnall sided with. Also: Tensions on the Highroad + Guardian Gigantus

name: The Ailing Arborheart
premise: Help the elves with their sickly sacred tree.
unlock: After A Trial of Archery + Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge

name: Dreams Apart
premise: Help someone you know cope in the changed world.
unlock: On reaching Unmoored World

name: When Wills Collide
premise: Settle a conflict in the changed world.
unlock: After Dreams Apart

name: A Scholarly Pursuit
premise: Assist a scholar studying what happened to the world.
unlock: After Unmoored World Trials

name: Halls of the First Dawn
premise: Prepare for the final trials of the post-game.
unlock: After Unmoored World Trials

name: The Regentkin's Resolve
premise: Help Brant with a task in the changed world.
unlock: After starting Halls of the First Dawn

name: Wandering Roots
premise: Help the elves save something from the Arborheart.
unlock: After starting Halls of the First Dawn

name: Civil Unrest
premise: Lead frightened people in Bakbattahl to safety.
unlock: After starting Halls of the First Dawn

name: The Importance of Aiding Ernesto
premise: Help a man at the volcanic island camp.
unlock: After starting Halls of the First Dawn

name: Shepherd of the Pawns
premise: Help pawns find their way in the changed world.
unlock: After starting Halls of the First Dawn

name: Chilling Tidings
premise: Answer a call for help from the frozen north.
tips: Start: talk to Captain Brant at the Stardrop Inn, Vernworth, at night.

name: Rumbles in the North
premise: Get your bearings in Norgan and meet its people.

name: Seeking the Sage
premise: Find a sage who can explain what is happening in Norgan.

name: Sealed History
premise: Uncover what Norgan's ruins are hiding.

name: The Castle in the Ice
premise: Reach the frozen castle and face what waits inside.

name: Soul Searching
premise: Search for a lost soul.

name: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
premise: Push on toward the source of Norgan's trouble.

name: Reunion
premise: Bring the Norgan story to its climax.

name: Into Rancor
premise: Descend into the depths for the DLC's true ending.

name: Sage's Wisdom: Riddle of the Body
premise: Solve one of the sage's three trials.

name: Sage's Wisdom: Riddle of the Soul
premise: Solve one of the sage's three trials.

name: Sage's Wisdom: Riddle of the Will
premise: Solve one of the sage's three trials.

name: Relics of the Past
premise: Learn how to appraise the relics (Spoils) found in Norgan.

name: Hammer and Tongs
premise: Help get the settlement's workshop running so you can craft.

name: In for a Hare, in for a Hound
premise: Help a hunter and earn a hound that sniffs out Spoils.

name: Oh, to be in Vermund
premise: Bring a homesick settler a taste of home.

name: Sticks and Stones
premise: Gather materials for new recipes.

name: A Direwolf Delicacy
premise: Hunt down a special meal.

name: Reaching the Far Shore
premise: Help a settler reach a distant shore. Unlocks layered armour (transmog).

name: Flight in the Night
premise: Help a trader escape at night and open a new shop.

name: Bout of Passage
premise: Prove yourself in a fight against Dwayne.

name: When the Culling Gets Tough
premise: Thin out monsters threatening the settlement.

name: A Howl in the Dark
premise: Hunt the beast that howls at night.

name: Quilt Me Down With a Feather
premise: Gather feathers for a warm quilt.

name: The Truant Soldier
premise: Find a soldier who left his post.

name: The Snatching-Beast
premise: Recover items stolen by a snow beast.

name: Hal's Treasure Hunt
premise: Follow Hal's clues to hidden treasure.

name: A Keepsake, for Your Sake
premise: Return a treasured keepsake.

name: Back to the Temple
premise: Return to the old temple for one last job.

name: Beyond Ruin-Night
premise: Face what is left after the ruin.

name: A Hound and His Bone
premise: Help your hound with a quest of its own.

name: No Spoils Get Left Behind
premise: Collect the last of the relics.

name: Lost Rites dungeons
area: Vermund, Battahl and the Unmoored World
premise: Twelve repeatable dungeons added to the original map, each with gear for every vocation.
unlock: Talk to Captain Brant at the Stardrop Inn, Vernworth, at night and ask about the uncovered ruins.
tips: Final chests give Offering Flames, needed for Norgan's Obelisks.
Final Proving Ground opens after you clear two other Unmoored World Lost Rites.
Vermund: Devilkin Hollow, Daemon's Corral, Sunken Spire, Interminable Corridor.
Battahl: Mired Conduit, Embersand Mine, Shrouded Warren, Precipitous Catacombs, Wyrmsblood Arena.
Unmoored World: Molten Gauntlet, Seafloor Sepulcher, Final Proving Ground.
